name: Time Knight
author: Solo Ramza Manager
summary_pt: Knight com Time Magicks (Haste, Stop, Quick, Gravity) e Rend.
description: A knight who bends time on the battlefield, hastening allies and freezing foes in place.

name: Druid
author: Solo Ramza Manager
summary_pt: Geomancer com Geomancy completa e curas brancas básicas.
description: A guardian of the wilds who calls on the land itself and mends wounds with nature's grace.

name: Shogun
author: Solo Ramza Manager
summary_pt: Samurai com Iaido completo, Focus, Shout e Rend Power/Speed.
description: A warlord of the blade who commands every katana technique and a warrior's resolve.

name: White Monk
author: Solo Ramza Manager
summary_pt: Monk com Martial Arts e White Magicks até Curaga e Holy.
description: A pilgrim who pairs a disciplined fist with healing prayers.

name: Arcane Archer
author: Solo Ramza Manager
summary_pt: Archer com Aim e Black Magicks de nível 1 e 2.
description: An archer who enchants each arrow with elemental magick.

name: Warlock
author: Solo Ramza Manager
summary_pt: Black Mage com magias -ja, Flare, debuffs de Mystic e Lich/Zodiark.
description: A seeker of forbidden knowledge who curses, confounds and slays with the darkest magicks.

name: Rogue
author: Solo Ramza Manager
summary_pt: Thief com Dual Wield inato, Steal completo e golpes do Squire/Monk.
description: A nimble thief who wields a blade in each hand and takes whatever isn't nailed down.

name: Troubadour
author: Solo Ramza Manager
summary_pt: Bard com todos os Bardsongs e todas as Dances.
description: A wandering performer who knows every song and every dance.

name: Alchemist
author: Solo Ramza Manager
summary_pt: Chemist com Items completo, Regen e Esuna, pode usar espada.
description: A field medic who never runs out of remedies, and can hold the line with a sword.

name: Freelancer
author: Solo Ramza Manager
summary_pt: Squire com um pouco de tudo: cura, magia, Haste, Steal e Rend.
description: A wanderer who picked up a little of everything along the way.

name: Glass Cannon
author: Solo Ramza Manager
summary_pt: DESAFIO: MA altíssimo e metade do HP. Todo o elemental, Flare e Meteor.
description: Immense magickal power in a body that shatters at a touch. Not for the faint of heart.
